import pydantic

from nova import api
from nova.types.pose import Pose


class RobotState(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Collection of information on the current state of the robot.

    This class represents the complete state of a robot at a given point in time.

    Attributes:
        pose (Pose): The current pose (position and orientation) of the robot.
        tcp (str | None): The TCP name.
        joints (tuple[float, ...]): A tuple of joint angles in radians for each
            joint of the robot.
    """

    pose: Pose
    tcp: str | None
    joints: tuple[float, ...]


class MotionState(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Collection of information on the current motion state of the robot"""

    motion_group_id: str
    path_parameter: float
    state: RobotState

Ported the changes from `feature/Use-commanded-joints-as-start-joints` onto `feat/pause-on-io-resume` via cherry-pick (clean auto-merge, no conflicts) as commit `2e87bb9b`:

- `RobotState` gains `commanded_joints`, `get_state()` populates it from `motion_group_state.execute.joint_position`
- `joints()` now prefers `commanded_joints` over the measured `joints`
- New robot models added to `MotionGroupModel` literal

Tests, ruff, and ty all pass. Nothing else on this branch touches those code paths, so it applied without conflicts.
